title: Visited Cells for General Configurations
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with $k$ work tapes over the same alphabet, with state sets $S_1$ and $S_2$, and choose states $exit\in S_1$ and $entry\in S_2$. Let $c_0,c_1$ be configurations of $M_1$ on the same input, and suppose $M_1$ reaches $c_1$ from $c_0$ after $T_1$ steps, with state $exit$, while avoiding state $exit$ at every time $t<T_1$. For every natural number $T_2$ and work-tape index $i$, the cells visited by tape $i$ in the seam-composed run from $c_0$ with its states embedded in the left component, through time $T_1+1+T_2$, are contained in the union of the cells visited by $M_1$ from $c_0$ through time $T_1$ and those visited by $M_2$ from $c_1$ with its state replaced by $entry$, through time $T_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ work tapes and a common input word
Machines $M_1,M_2$ over a common alphabet with state sets $S_1,S_2$
The run from $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ at time $T_1$
The run avoids state $exit$ at every time $t<T_1$
